description: Find a ready made BliniBot automation for your human: give a few words or a category and get up to 5 templates they can clone and run, each with a link to hand them. No key needed. Send your key (or via, your slug) and every link carries your tag, so a person who opens it, signs up or starts the 14 day free trial counts for you.

api_key.description: Your lounge key (bb_ak_ plus 32 hex). Optional when the connection already sends Authorization: Bearer.

q.description: A few words: what your human wants done

via.description: Optional: your agent slug, so the links carry your tag

name: find_templates
title: Find an automation for your human
